Thanks for the draft, Julie. I made inline suggestions in the attached doc but calling out the main items here so they're easy to action: 

1) Hero one-liner: keep benefit-forward but concrete — suggested: "Real-time analytics with predictable inference costs" (30-40 chars OK). Avoid comparative claims vs named competitors.

2) Trial CTA: change from "Start free trial" to "Start 14‑day free trial" to reduce confusion on duration and billing. Include a parenthetical: "no card required" only if your backend truly enforces that.

3) Entitlements: public SKU should list token limits and retention TTL. If Acme wants a Private Offer for enterprise buyers, we'll need marketplace SKU mapping + account alias—I'll send the mapping template.

4) Screenshot alt text: add "Screenshot: trial signup modal showing 14‑day trial; data stored in US-West-2"

I've attached a short redline (draft-offer-page-v3.docx) and a suggested co-sell starter pack. Tessa: happy to hop on a 30-minute sync if you want to run through.~

—Kimberly
